parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file is declared as domain because it matches **/*.entity.ts, but the InvoiceEntity class does persistence mapping. @Entity('invoices') binds the class to a database table name. @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid') tells the database how to generate the id. @Column() marks orderId and amount as table columns. That work belongs to the infrastructure (persistence) layer. The only domain behaviour is hasId(), which is trivial, so the class is mainly an ORM persistence model sitting in the domain layer. Import direction is out of scope, so this judgement rests on the mapping responsibility, not on the 'typeorm' import itself. Confidence is moderate because some projects deliberately accept TypeORM-annotated entities as domain objects, and the layer model's *.entity.ts pattern hints at that convention. No ADR prose was given to approve it, though.
